description: This file defines the functionality for deleting a follower relationship in a social media or follower system, including request validation, handling the delete command, and retrieving the updated profile.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Username in the delete command is neither null nor empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete follower request, removing the follower relationship if it exists and returning the updated profile.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Processes the delete follower command, removing the follower relationship from the database and returning the user's profile.
